findings.issue: Skill link `[skills/code-reviewing/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/code-reviewing/SKILL.md)` uses a bare path that does not resolve from `work/04-remember-me-cookie/tasks/2.md`. From this location, `.claude/...` resolves to `work/04-remember-me-cookie/tasks/.claude/...` (does not exist). Tasks 1 and 4 correctly use `../../../.claude/skills/...`.
findings.fix: Replace with `[skills/code-reviewing/SKILL.md](../../../.claude/skills/code-reviewing/SKILL.md)` to match the prefix used in Task 1 and Task 4.

findings.issue: Skill link `[skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md)` uses a bare path that does not resolve from `tasks/3.md`. Resolves to `work/04-remember-me-cookie/tasks/.claude/...` (does not exist).
Frontmatter omits the optional `teammate_name:` field that is present in Tasks 1, 2, 4, 5 and in the template. Cosmetic inconsistency across the batch.
findings.fix: Add `teammate_name:` (empty) to Task 3 frontmatter for consistency with the rest of the batch and the template.

findings.issue: Skill link `[skills/pre-deploy-qa/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/pre-deploy-qa/SKILL.md)` uses a bare path that does not resolve from `tasks/5.md`.

Task 4 (Test Audit) declares `verify: []` in frontmatter but the Verification Steps → Automated subsection prescribes running `./gradlew :backend:test --tests ...` as a sanity check. Task 2 (Code Audit) explicitly states the auditor does NOT run tests. Inconsistent posture across audit tasks for the same wave; if Task 4 truly runs a gradle command it should declare `verify: [smoke]` or remove the command and rely on Task 5 for execution.
findings.fix: Either add `verify: [smoke]` to frontmatter and clearly justify the test-execution as part of the audit, or remove the gradle invocations from Verification Steps to align with the audit-only posture documented in Task 2.

findings.issue: Verification Steps → Automated subsection in Task 3 only restates that the audit report file must exist — there is no actual command, MCP tool call, or executable check. For a task with `verify: []` and reviewers `[]`, this is acceptable, but the section content is essentially a duplicate of an Acceptance Criterion.
findings.fix: Either omit the Automated subsection (allowed for non-code tasks) or replace its content with a real self-check command (e.g., `test -f work/04-remember-me-cookie/logs/working/task-3/security-audit-report.md`).

decomposition.notes: Five-task split matches tech-spec Implementation Tasks: Wave 1 (Task 1 implementation) → Audit Wave (Tasks 2/3/4 in parallel) → Final Wave (Task 5 QA). Dependency chain valid, no cycles. Shared resource RememberMeWebSessionIdResolver has single owner (Task 1); audit/QA consumers all declare depends_on:[1] (or chain via 2/3/4). No competing instances. Task count proportional to S-sized bug fix. AC and TDD anchors carried forward from tech-spec without loss.
